name: needs-cost-visual
description: Visual check of need costs (#928 — fatigue is the sole gauge, and it has always cost $0 per rest, NEED_REST_COSTS.fatigue): after draining fatigue and building living_quarters, advance ticks to trigger rest visits; verify the finances panel/output NEVER shows a 'needs'-category expense line despite the rest visits happening — cash still decreases from ordinary payroll and building upkeep, but never from a rest itself. See RestActionHelpers.test.ts's own deductRestCost unit coverage for the exact zero-cost/no-transaction assertions this scenario's screenshots visually confirm.

steps.description: Resolved through the event dialog's own buttons. Decides whether an event is pending from authoritative game state, not from whether the modal has rendered -- a DOM-only probe silently missed events on a no-GPU runner where a frame costs ~6s, leaving them pending so later ticks halted and the run diverged while still passing command mode.

expect.note: Ordering only queues a construction site (#556); the lone driller hired above walks over and builds it during the tick blocks below, so this step asserts the site and the ticks that follow are what make it real.
